output.summary: Review 1 fixes in 3bdf926. Any registered repo is checked whatever its lane state, and the Hub is asked only through ready lanes. An unreported verdict is resent before checking again. A git or VM failure is reported only after 3 tries over 10 minutes. The summary carries the full commit. A paused Office resumes a held check, and presence and restart see a running check. A foreign Story base is refused, and URL credentials are stripped. New tests cover these, the open-record gate, NOT_YOURS during the VM run and stop(). RED 6/10 targeted on 7364708 -> GREEN 1985/1985; tsc 0. M8 (two Macs of one PL) is a recorded limit.
